Thanks for the context — I reviewed their brief and cluster sizing estimate. A few points:

- $20k hosted credits + 1-week extension is acceptable as a standard pilot deal for Series A with referenced token volumes.
- We should add an obligation in the quote: 30-day evaluation metrics (latency P95 < 400ms on their pilot profile, cost per 1k tokens under agreed threshold) and share simple telemetry tags so we can instrument Optimize suggestions.
- Finance: Rafa, they are not asking for invoiced credits — so it’s promotional. Please confirm we’re good to consume SOC/marketing credit budget for this.

Rafa: if you sign off, I’ll prepare a short MPA (mutual pilot agreement) and a HubSpot quote with expiration 30 days. Grace: when you send to Courtney, include a line that credits expire 90 days after activation.
